name: M3_MMS120MI_DeAllocateOrLne
description: Deallocate allocated stock for a specific order line. This operation removes existing allocation from one order line of an order, based on the stock transaction type and allocation origin. It works across different order categories (for example customer, distribution, or manufacturing issues) and returns the previously allocated quantity to available stock. The logic is part of detailed allocation handling in M3 and follows the same allocation rules as the interactive allocation functions, but without any returned data; it only updates the allocation status on the selected line.

inputParameters.name: TTYP
inputParameters.description: Stock transaction type indicating which kind of order transaction the deallocation relates to.

inputParameters.name: RIDN
inputParameters.description: Order number identifying the order from which allocation is removed.

inputParameters.name: RIDL
inputParameters.description: Order line number on the order whose allocation is removed.

inputParameters.name: MAAL
inputParameters.description: Code specifying the origin or method of the allocation to be removed, such as manual or automatic.

inputParameters.name: RIDX
inputParameters.description: Line suffix identifying a subline or sequence within the order line to deallocate, when applicable.

inputParameters.name: ALQT
inputParameters.description: Quantity to deallocate in the item's basic unit of measure, used when removing only part of the allocation.
